runs.name: Steel Dynamics, Inc.; no rename, spin-off or split in the 8-Ks since 2025-06; the remaining 55% of New Process Steel bought for cash 2025-12-01
runs.entry: Price **$240.63** (quote of 2026-10-13 through `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **143,328,088**, one class (10-Q cover at 2026-07-23, `0001104659-26-087414`; `cover_shares.py` the same; 268,694,947 issued less 125,084,889 treasury = 143,610,058 on the 2026-06-30 balance sheet; $261M of Q3 2026 buybacks after the cover per the 8-K of 2026-09-18, `0001104659-26-108777`, said, not adjusted); cap **$34,489M**; net debt **$3,614M** (debt $4,182.1M less cash $567.7M at 2026-06-30; operating leases $171.7M and redeemable noncontrolling interests $143.3M left out, said so). Sovereign **5.60%** (US Treasury par curve, 30-year, 2026-10-09). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (`0001104659-26-021395`), 10-Q to 2026-06-30, proxy 2026 (`0001104659-26-035826`), 10-Ks FY2023, FY2021, FY2019 for the segment history, 8-Ks on the notes, New Process Steel, the CEO succession (`0001104659-26-090129`) and guidance; one figure cross-checked (FY2025 operating cash $1,449,534 thousand against the filed statement, with depreciation and capital spending). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file (segment income over two cycles, cost position against rivals 2016 to 2025, capital spending and what it earned, acquisitions, debt, buybacks and prices, stock pay, quarterly guidance, litigation and environment, the CEO succession). Competitors: the 10-K names none; the analyst took Nucor, Cleveland-Cliffs and Commercial Metals from the proxy's performance-share peer group as a CONVENTION of the run (Metallus left out under the limit of three); all file with the SEC; rival figures from tagged XBRL, not read from their statements. Q1 IN (tons times metal spread less conversion cost against the capital in the mills; the carbon-steel row **[M2000-038]** weighed as a remark about one company). **Q2 IN on the deciding part**, steel operations, 68% of 2021 to 2025 segment operating income: pre-tax margin 2016 to 2025 equal to Nucor's at 14.3% on the sum, above CMC every year and CLF every steel year; returns held through the volume declines of 2020 and 2024 (7.4% and 11.3%); the money test fails (the company built Sinton itself; Item 1A on new EAF capacity), carried to Q7; FY2009 to FY2015 about 2.0% pre-tax on sales written down. Q3 weighs against (capital spending $8,641M against depreciation $3,759M over 2016 to 2025; added capital about 11% pre-tax trough to trough; about $2.9B in aluminum earning nothing yet). Q4 accounts IN, weighs against on quarterly guidance met or beaten in five of five quarters and Adjusted EBITDA featured. Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for (Sinton ramp and aluminum against). Q6 undecided on both parts: retention passes; buybacks name no price, May and June 2026 purchases at $237.06 and $269.60 above the range bottom, June above the top; bonus pool on an adjusted income that excludes start-up losses. **Q7 OUT, on price**: cycle base 2021 to 2025 (2021 aberrational, specific (a)); owner cash before interest $1,304M (all spending and purchases) and $2,248M (maintenance, depreciation the guess, specific (e)); cycle-to-cycle growth 23.2% cut under specific (f) to sales growth 14.3% then to the discount rate 5.6%; not a serial acquirer; range **$228.24 to $254.89 a share all-equity** (equity-only $242.68 to $273.20) against $240.63; whole-business price $38,103M yields 3.4% and 5.9%; no case earns the floor, only the uncut 23% case would; the price sits inside a narrow range; fair **$120.05 all-equity**, **$140.49 equity-only**. Q8 to Q12 not reached; facts after the stop: notes $4,286.6M due 2027 to 2055, revolver $1.2B undrawn, coverage covenant 13.33 against 2.50. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session context's commit subjects of the CLF run, which name a margin comparison including STLD, not opened, Q2 computed from the filers' own XBRL by the run's own script; other research folder names from git status; none used. Commits 2ce5bf5c to 6e371993, nine. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for STLD or Steel Dynamics). Citations: the analyst's check passed; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_check.py` 103 ids, 50 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, one hit read as not a slip: "the low-cost producer" beside **[M2001-013]** in the unclear section is the framework's phrase, quoted as such, with the id supporting the reading that parity suffices. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the box turns on specific (f): the uncut case alone would earn the floor. The analyst's gaps: (1) specific (f) does not name the sales base, and against sales carried at their own growth it can never fire in a commodity business; (2) specific (a) does not say what growth to carry when the window is the cycle and successive cycles differ mainly by price level; (3) the commodity paragraph does not say the low-cost exception answers Q2's money test, or whether cost parity with one rival is the low-cost title; (4) no standing rule for competitors when the 10-K names none (proxy peers suggested); (5) whether a depreciation proxy counts as the filing allowing the maintenance guess; (6) capitalized interest under the all-equity add-back; (7) intra-quarter guidance against the make-the-numbers paragraph. Could not get: maintenance capital, Q3 2026 buyback prices, rivals' figures from their filed statements; CMC's August year end and CLF's short steel record flagged.
runs.narr: Q7 OUT, on price: the EAF steelmaker and scrap recycler, Q1 IN, Q2 IN on steel operations as a low-cost producer at parity with Nucor (pre-tax margin 14.3% each over 2016 to 2025, ahead of CMC and CLF, returns held through the volume declines of 2020 and 2024; the money test fails, carried to Q7), Q3 weighs against (capital spending more than twice depreciation, the aluminum mill earning nothing yet), Q4 accounts IN, Q5 integrity IN, Q6 undecided. At $240.63 no case earns the floor; range $228.24 to $254.89 a share all-equity, with the 23.2% cycle-to-cycle growth cut to 5.6% under specific (f), which the analyst says decides the box; fair price $120.05 all-equity, $140.49 equity-only.
